info.title: ANVISA Consultas Externas API
info.description: Consultas públicas da ANVISA: UDI de dispositivos médicos, nomes técnicos, fila de análise, listas e assuntos de peticionamento (observadas ao vivo em 2026-09) e, desde 2026-10-01, produtos para saúde, certificados de boas práticas (genéricos e de medicamentos) e tabaco (observados ao vivo em 2026-10-22). Esta descrição foi corrigida por overlay a partir do comportamento observado: veja `x-anvisa-client-requirements`.

post.description: Paginated UDI search. At least one `filter` key is required; an empty filter fails with HTTP 500 and `mensagem: mensagens.MSG-062`. Verified live: `nomeComercial` (substring), `udiDi` (exact), `cnpjDetentora`, `codigoGmdn`, `nuRegistro`; the other keys come from the published example and are untested. The filter check runs before the page check: `page: 0` with an empty filter still yields MSG-062, not the page-index error.

500.description: Internal error OR request validation failure (see ErroApi.mensagem / mensagem_detalhada).

post.description: Paginated GMDN term search; names and definitions are in Portuguese. Works with an empty `filter`. Verified live: `conteudo` (text); `codigo` from ANVISA's example is untested.

post.description: Paginated produtos derivados do tabaco (3,578 rows on 2026-10-22). Works with an empty `filter`. Verified live: `nomeProduto` (1 row for "7 PONTAS"); `cnpjEmpresa` and `cnpj` are silently ignored (the whole table comes back). The list view leaves `embalagens`, `rotulos`, `idProduto`, `origem` and `categoriaAditivos` empty; the detail fills them.

500.description: Internal error OR request validation failure (see ErroApi.mensagem / mensagem_detalhada).

post.description: Paginated produtos para saúde (193,109 rows on 2026-10-22). Works with an empty `filter`. Verified live: `nomeProduto` (prefix/substring: "1000VINYL" matched 3 rows) and `cnpj` (31 rows for 05993698000107); the other keys of the example are untested.

post.summary: Faz download do relatório de fila
post.description: Exports one whole subqueue as a spreadsheet (`consulta_fila.xlsx`, 40 rows after a 7-row header block for subfila 167 on 2026-09-08). The file is OOXML (magic `PK`) despite the `application/vnd.ms-excel` content type. `filter.subfila` is required and `page`/`size` are ignored, as in /fila/consulta. A subfila with nothing queued is HTTP 500 "Nenhum resultado encontrado para exportação." here, not the empty 404 that /fila/consulta gives.

post.x-observed-sizes: Whole queues observed on 2026-09-06: subfila 167 → 40 rows, subfila 161 → 35 rows, subfila 1742 → 71 rows; the sibling /lista/consulta returned 555 rows through the same DTO. No size cap. A full crawl of all 314 subfilas listed by the catalogs held 10,390 rows.
post.x-empty-queue: A subfila with nothing queued answers HTTP 404 with an empty body, not an empty array (88 of 314 subfilas on 2026-09-06, e.g. 1721 and 2609). An unknown id gets the same.

At least one filter key besides `contexto` is required, otherwise HTTP 500 `mensagens.MSG-013`. Verified live: `nacional` + `internacional`, `status` and `cnpjSolicitante` (7 rows for 39809660000153; international certificates carry no cnpjCertificada). The lookup-backed keys (classesCertificacao, formasFarmaceuticas, linhasCertificacao, certificacaoConcedidaPor) are untested.

post.description: Exports assuntos as `consulta_assuntos.xls` (BIFF .xls). An empty `filter` exports all 2,599 assuntos, about 5 MB. `filter.codigosAssunto` (an array of ids) does bind here, unlike POST /api/v1/assunto/ which cannot bind its body at all: `{"filter": {"codigosAssunto": [10013]}}` returned a 13 KB file on 2026-09-08.

ErroApi.description: Envelope returned with HTTP 500 for both internal errors and request validation failures (missing required filter, page < 1, malformed body).

mensagem.description: Human message, or an unresolved i18n key such as `mensagens.MSG-062` (= at least one filter is required).

data_hora.description: Server-local timestamp as [year, month, day, hour, minute, second, nanosecond].

mensagem_detalhada.description: Detail text, e.g. "Filtro 'subfila' não informado." or a Java stack message.

Keycloak.description: Keycloak OAuth2 client credentials (realm `externo`). The access token expires in 1740 s (the portal's token tutorial says 300; the live value is 1740) and no refresh token is issued; request a new token with the same credentials. The JWT carries `aud: [consultas-externas-service, account]` and the single role `CONSULTASEXTERNAS_LEITURA`; there are no per-endpoint scopes.

X-RateLimit-Remaining.description: Tokens left in the bucket after this request (shared per source address).

x-anvisa-client-requirements.userAgent: Required. Cloudflare answers HTTP 403 (HTML "Attention Required") to curl's default User-Agent, even for this spec document. Send a descriptive User-Agent.

rateLimit.type: token bucket (Spring Cloud Gateway). Observed 2026-09-06 to be shared between the authenticated API and the unauthenticated portal backend on the same gateway, i.e. keyed by source address rather than by client_id.

x-anvisa-client-requirements.dates: All date-time fields are sent as integer epoch milliseconds.
x-anvisa-client-requirements.errors: Request validation failures are returned as HTTP 500 with the `ErroApi` envelope, not as 400.
